invariants: trace_id is a non-zero 16-byte lowercase hexadecimal identifier
span_id and parent_span_id are non-zero 8-byte lowercase hexadecimal identifiers
correlation_id, request_id and tenant_id are required and immutable across a governed execution
child spans preserve trace_id and refer to a valid parent span when one exists
evidence references carry immutable SHA-256 digests and never imply evidence validity by presence alone
context carries identifiers and bounded safe attributes only; secrets, credentials, prompts and raw sensitive payloads are forbidden
trace context is observability metadata and never grants identity, tenant, policy, approval or execution authority
trace records must connect request, policy decision, approval, execution, tool call, event and evidence lineage
